GHA.note: Minister raises bias in AI models trained without African data; no rule, authority or draft is stated.
AI skills training for civil servants only; no government AI system is described.
No AI tool in a public sector system is described.

facts.fact: Minister Samuel Nartey George says Ghana is committing US$250 million over the next two years to AI computing infrastructure, intended as a regional hub giving neighbouring countries, universities, researchers and start-ups access to high-performance computing.
